name: corbel
description: Search and call the Procore REST API (3,000+ endpoints) from Claude, read-only by default. Unofficial; not affiliated with Procore.

client_id.title: Procore client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of your Procore developer app (service account / client credentials).

client_secret.title: Procore client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the same Procore developer app.

company_id.title: Procore company ID
company_id.description: Numeric company ID sent as the Procore-Company-Id header.

allow_writes.title: Allow changes to Procore
allow_writes.description: Set to true to enable the create, update and delete tools. Leave false for read-only.
